facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M quarterly report for July to September 2025 says 'work has commenced on the development of Malawi's National Digital Transformation Strategy', building on the Digital Readiness Assessment, 'developed through a consultative process'; the report's plans for the next period are to 'develop and validate' the strategy together with an AI strategy. The event falls in the reporting quarter, no month given.
